reason: Full independent review verified the complete pinned raw and matching SHA-256, receipt/candidate and suggestion agreement, all five exact quotes and locators, canonical/raw provenance, linked navigation targets, root-to-provider-to-braintree-in-person discovery, and the unique reciprocal anchor. The candidate otherwise preserves the In-Person GraphQL authentication identity; first-party versus multi-merchant OAuth distinction; secure credential custody; per-merchant token storage, expiry monitoring and refresh responsibility; separate Sandbox account roles; and snapshot, environment, eligibility, credential-validity and execution boundaries. One material scope substitution remains: the raw says the first-party option also fits a solution in which the merchant is fully responsible for the API-calling code and surrounding infrastructure, whereas the overview, detail locator and reciprocal proposal call that condition merchant-owned. Responsibility is not ownership, so this can misselect authentication for merchant-responsible infrastructure that the merchant does not own.
required_changes: Replace the unsupported ownership wording in all three retrieval surfaces: change 'merchant-owned calling infrastructure' in the Overview, 'merchant-owned caller condition' in the Detail locators, and 'merchant-owned caller' in the reciprocal proposal to wording that preserves the raw condition, such as 'merchant-responsible API-calling code and surrounding infrastructure.' For the concrete query 'Which authentication option applies when the merchant is fully responsible for the API-calling code and infrastructure but does not own that infrastructure?', the current summaries can wrongly exclude the documented first-party API-key option. The raw route is insufficient because both the source overview/locator and the main-concept reciprocal are selection surfaces and repeat the narrower ownership condition before a retriever decides whether to open the raw. Keep the already-correct Key takeaways wording and all existing credential, account-role, environment, time and execution boundaries unchanged.
